text_fidelity_a: Mattel Games Ghostbusters Game This has to be one of the most complicated games to play I have ever seen.  I don’t even want to try and explain it.  So convoluted is this came. .  . I have NO Idea how kids ages 8 – 12 (recommended age) are supposed to play it.  Perhaps I’m not giving kids enough credit, but even if you do figure out how to play. .  . .I think it’s boring.  The game is Made in China.
text_fidelity_b: Mattel Games Ghostbusters Game

text_fidelity_a: Barbie Video Game Hero Match Game Princess Doll, Pink This is a complete variation from the typical "BARBIE" doll. Her face has large exaggerated eyes that look like many of the anima cartoons. She is more of a game in a doll's body.  The legs do not move and the only movement that the arms have is at the shoulder. Her head does swivel back and forth. Her clothes are molded on and cannot be changed. This is a throw-back to the old "SIMON" game that I played as a kid. You press the yellow button on her belt and her skirt lights up in different order and sequence. The purpose is to press the coordinating blue or red buttons on belt to match the order of the lights.  It has five levels of difficulty and music that plays when you press the buttons. My four year old granddaughter would press the buttons just to watch the lights and listen to the sound.  Half of her hair is pink and the other half is purple and she comes with a crown and a helmet. She has knee pads on that will detach and roller-skates that actually turn and help her to stand on her own. The packaging that she came in is torn. The plastic cover is almost completely detach from the cardboard bottom.  This is because it came in a padded envelope and not a box.  Overall she is very cute and she is definitely worth the purchase.
text_fidelity_b: Barbie Video Game Hero Match Game Princess Doll, Pink

text_fidelity_a:
Fisher-Price Nickelodeon Shimmer & Shine, Shimmer I have the “Shine” doll. This is just your basic little Made in China doll. The doll is about six-inches toll. She bends at the waist. The arms move up-and-down, but do not bed. Very colorful. This doll doesn’t “do” anything. . . as in there is no sound, or anything like that. Other dolls with do offer sound and such are offered. This is just a nice little carry-around doll.

The only “issue” (which I have reported) was that it was shipped in a padded envelope, and arrived as an open package. Hopefully they have started shipping in a box.

text_fidelity_a: Revell SnapTite Build & Play Rebel U-wing Fighter Building Kit This is a very easy model to build, with not many pieces.  Once put together, it looks nice.  I like the fact that once you put it together, you can actually play with it.  With some other kits, that’s not really the case, and they are more for “display only”.  Revell makes a nice assortment of Star Wars models.  I will say that this is not one of the more “splashy” models that Revell makes. . . . but a nice one to either start with or add to your collection.
text_fidelity_b: Revell SnapTite Build & Play Rebel U-wing Fighter Building Kit

text_fidelity_a:
Oball Go Grippers Loader This is a colorful loader. It rolls well and is quite large. If you fill the bucket with anything that has any weight to it at all, it tends to tip-over.

The one thing that I’m really not that fond of about the design of these “Go Grippers” are all the holes. It would be find if all of the holes were large. . . but they are not. text_fidelity_b: Oball Go Grippers Loader

text_fidelity_a:
Alex DIY Knot-A-Quilt Pattern Kids Art and Craft Activity This is a super easy “quilt” kit. Note that it comes in a few different patterns, and prices can vary quite a bit, depending upon the pattern, so if the pattern doesn’t matter as much, you might them all to see which one is least expensive.

It’s really just as simple as tying the squares together. Just keep in mind that this is more of a “toy”. It’s not great quality and I certainly would not want to try and wash it. Having said that, it’s a nice indoor project, and hopefully gets kids interested in more advanced craft projects.
text_fidelity_b: Alex DIY Knot-A-Quilt Pattern Kids Art and Craft Activity

text_fidelity_a: Be Amazing! Toys Soda Powered Science Kit At the current price of twenty bucks, this is a very expensive kit for what it is.  Having said that, it certainly is great fun for kids.  There are several things you will need. . . . First is good weather!  This is an outdoor project only, so it really doesn’t work for cold weather.  It’s a Summer type of kit.  Next, you’ll need several bottles of diet cola.  “Generic” works just as well as “name-brand”.  Though you can use “regular” soda, I don’t recommend it, as you’ll have sticky sugar syrup everywhere. .  .and ants!  You’ll also need several tubes of peppermint Mentos.  This is way less about “science”. . . and more just fun to watch it happen.
text_fidelity_b: Be Amazing! Toys Soda Powered Science Kit

text_fidelity_a:
Ann Williams – Rubber Band Game – Award-Winning Game for Family & Friends The blocks are foam, covered in paper. The paper has some kind of “wood” designs on it, but the blocks are indeed foam. That means that it doesn’t take a lot to knock them down.

Though there are different “games” described in the instructions. . . .depending upon the kids. . . .it may end-up being just time spent setting-up blocks and knocking them down with rubber bands.

You’ll want to be careful, as the rubber bands and (and will) go everywhere! It shows for kids 8 and up. . . It’s not really recommended for younger kids, especially being that hitting someone in the face/eye with the rubber bands.

text_fidelity_a: My Little Pony Wonderbolts Lord Tirek Castle Ruins Playset This is a cool dragon. . .  albeit quite expensive for plastic Made in China.  It’s cool that it makes noise, and the eyes light-up.  Three AAA batteries are required and “demo” batteries are included, which means that they will not last long, and you’ll need more.  You can, of course, play with the dragon even without batteries.  It includes the dragon and “Little Spike” figure.  “Guardians of Harmony” pony figures can also ride the dragon, and are sold separately.  It’s a very cool dragon. . . I just wish it was a little more reasonably priced.

text_fidelity_a: Scientific Explorer Geo Smash Mining This is a fun, albeit messy, “mining” kit.  Gems are encased in plaster and kids must hammer. . . bang. . . smash. . .  .scrape. . . . to get them out.  The one tool which is almost useless is the “brush”.  I think there might be a half-dozen bristles on it.  You’re better-off with an old toothbrush.  You’ll want to start this project either outside. . . . or in the garage. . .  .or at least with a lot of newspaper laid-out.  There’s really not a lot to it, but kids LOVE it.  Getting to “dig around” and actually find things. . . It’s quite cool.

text_fidelity_a:
4M T-Rex Dinosaur DNA Kit, 4945, Multi First of all. . . . As you might expect. . . .This is going to be a messy project. Outside, or in a garage, is probably best.

The little plastic mallet, which is included, may not work for you. . . especially if you would like to “excavate” the bones in a timely manner. So you might want to pull-out a toolbox with a screwdriver. Whatever you have which will do the job. An old toothbrush might also help with cleaning the bones.

For the relatively low cost, it’s a fun project. . . Just don’t have your expectations too high. If you’re looking for something similar, but a bit better quality, then you might also check-out the one from Smithsonian.

text_fidelity_a: Franklin Sports Disney Frozen 8.5" Playground Ball - Elsa/Anna This is. . . . more-or-less. . .  a small kickball.  “Official” kickballs are 10”, and this one is 8.5”.  It has a nice look to it.  There is texture on the ball, but the artwork still looks nice.  It also has nice bounce to it.  For Made in China, at the current price of almost eighteen bucks, it’s crazy expensive.  But it’s a “Frozen” ball, so there you have it.  The same sort of design is offered in other types of balls, but most are equally expensive.  If you don’t have to have a “Frozen” ball, then “regular” kickballs are a fraction of the cost.
text_fidelity_b: Franklin Sports Disney Frozen 8.5" Playground Ball - Elsa/Anna

text_fidelity_a:
Thames & Kosmos Barbie STEM Kit with Nikki Scientist Doll Note that this kit comes in two different versions. . . One is with Barbie (white doll). The other (this one) is with Nikki (darker-skin doll). Both of the kits are exactly the same, other than the doll.

This is the kind of kit that’s probably best enjoyed by both an adult and child together. .. especially if the child is younger. Though it shows from 4 – 8-years, I think four and five are quite young for a kit like this. Again, it could work for some kids, and with an adult.

Overall it’s nice that this is a “learning” sort of kit. There are a couple of “issues”. First of all, though there are seven building projects, you can’t build each one without taking the last one apart. It would have been nice if it were possible to build each one without having to do that. Also, all of the projects are “girlie”. Because Nikki is supposed to be a scientist, it would have been nice of at least a couple of the projects were “non-girlie”.
text_fidelity_b: Thames & Kosmos Barbie STEM Kit with Nikki Scientist Doll

text_fidelity_a: Ben Franklin Toys Electronic Bill & Coin Counter Bank with LCD Screen, One Size In theory this is a great idea, but this counter falls short of what it is supposed to do.  It should recognize the coins that you place into the plastic cup, but it does not do a very of job distinguishing between the coins and therefore you cannot get an accurate balance. The LCD Display at first glance is impressive, but it requires batteries that are not enclosed.  It is advertised as a toy and that is about all it is.  It does not teach accurately how to use or count money and the only thing an adult could use it for is to keep coins.  You would still have to count the coins when the cup is full because you cannot trust the counter to work properly. My suggestion would be to use a bowl or some other container to keep your change in and do not spend the money on this item.
text_fidelity_b: Ben Franklin Toys Electronic Bill & Coin Counter Bank with LCD Screen, One Size

text_fidelity_a: Revell Junior Fire Truck Model Kit, Red This is what is considered by Revell to be a “Level 1” model kit.  It has 41-pieces, which is still a fair number of pieces. BRIO Magnetic Stacking Train This Brio train is like building blocks, which create a train. . . . .which then rolls around. No track is necessary.

On the one hand, it sounds like a nice idea. . . but in reality there are a few “issues”.

First, the blocks are magnetic on one side only. The side which is magnetic is not marked. They should have marked them, or made all of the sides magnetic. As it is, you’re stuck “searching” for the magnetic side. This does not work very well, especially for younger children.

text_fidelity_a:
Blade Inductrix FPV RTF (Yellow) I am a complete newbie to drones. I've operated one of the Phantom 3 drones that my son owns, which is a completely different animal. So, out of the box, I was completely dependent on the instructions to get me up and running. After looking through the last of five instruction sheets, I finally found the English version. Without going into great detail, I'll just say that it was not easy at all finding and understanding the basic minimum to get you in the air. There is a lot of terminology about components that I had no idea what was being referred to. Example: Three-in-one control unit. It took me considerable time to figure out that the three-in-one control unit is a part of the quad copter itself. Now, it must be acknowledged that this is an unbelievable amount of technology in such a small package. So I guess it's a little much to expect that it would be simple to operate. But after getting the battery charged and after a few trials and errors, I got the copter in the air. The included video screen actually has a reasonably clear picture. And after a lot of practice I got to where I could fly it through my house, upstairs from controlling downstairs and still got good video reception and control. This little unit is built pretty tough. And it needs to be, because, especially if you're a newbie, you'll crash a lot. It really took a beating on my hardwood floors. Carpeted floors would be a lot easier on the equipment. While the drone is very durable and has built in protection for the video camera, I broke several of the stanchions that attach the motors to the circular blade guard. I was able to use instant glue and get back in the air. But the good news is that individual parts are sold separately so it can evidently be fairly easily repaired.

This little drone is very fun to fly. Battery life on the one single included battery is consistently about 3 minutes per flight. It takes about 15 minutes to charge. As has been recommended in several articles I've read, I will be purchasing additional batteries and a gang-charger. I'll give this unit four stars. The value for the price is, I believe, very good. The main frustrating drawback is the lack of more simple and basic instructions. It's far from an "open-the-box-and-fly" unit. But if you have the patience to stick with it and improve your skills, it's tremendously fun to fly!
text_fidelity_b: Blade Inductrix FPV RTF (Yellow)

Zootopia Police Station, Playset for Kids This playset comes with two figures. . . Clawhauser, and Safety Squirrel. Additional figures are sold separately, and you’ll probably want to add some so that you can actually play with this set. (See links below) Without more figures, it’s hard to make this set come-to-life. There are some lights / sounds and several moving parts. It’s a rather large set. text_fidelity_a: Fisher-Price Imaginext Power Rangers Command Center This is a rather large item.  It comes with two figures, so you can start play right away.  Additional action figures are sold separately.  There are several moving parts and a cannon which fires.  But honestly, it doesn’t “do” lot.  The video at the top of the listing shows it well. It’s more for “imaginary play”.  It has a nice look to it though.  Cool and colorful.  Three AA batteries are required, and included.  I always like the “included” part.  Kind of expensive for Made in China molded plastic, but I like it.
text_fidelity_b: Fisher-Price Imaginext Power Rangers Command Center

text_fidelity_a:
DINOTRUX REPTOOL CONTROL TY RUX This is a VERY cool remote controlled toy. It requires 3 AAA batteries and 4 AA batteries. . . which are not included. So you’ll certainly want to remember these, especially if you’re giving it as a gift.

It’s simple enough, but instead of just going forwards and backwards (like most entry-level remote controlled toys) this one also “dances”. . . . swings the wrecking ball around. . . has forty phrases. . . will follow you around. . . and “find” you within eight-feet. The video at the top is quite good at explaining all of this.

Note that you can’t play with it much without the remote. In other words, it does not roll around manually and such.

At the current price of forty-eight bucks, it’s kind of expensive. . . but I still REALLY like it! So much fun!
text_fidelity_b: DINOTRUX REPTOOL CONTROL TY RUX

text_fidelity_a: WWE MATTEL Crash Cage Play Set This Made in China. . . overpriced molded plastic cage / ring set is cool.  Note that it does not come with figures, so you will have to supply your own. Once it’s put together, it looks cool, but it’s a bit “fragile”.  Not super high quality.  Though you can certainly play with it, I almost think of it more as a “display” sort of thing.  At the current price of thirty-five bucks, it’s not cheap. . . . but it’s more of a one-of-a-kind sort of thing, so it is cool.
text_fidelity_b: WWE MATTEL Crash Cage Play Set

text_fidelity_a: Adora Baby Doll Portable Table Feeding Seat for 20 dolls This is a cute . .  .and albeit expensive. .  . .item. .  .but. .  .it’s mostly for play tables.  If the table is more than 1.5” thick, then it’s not going to work.  If you have such a table, then it will be fine.  It works not only with Adora Dolls but lots of dolls and stuffed animals as well.  No assembly is required.  But at the current price of twenty bucks for Made in China, I think it’s quite expensive.
text_fidelity_b: Adora Baby Doll Portable Table Feeding Seat for 20 dolls

text_fidelity_a:
Barbie Star Light Adventure Lights & Sounds Hoverboarder I like that this Barbie doesn’t come attached to the hoverboard. This way you can play with her apart from the board as well. If you view the video at the top of the listing, you will see exactly how the hoverboard works. Once you attach Barbie to it, and you fly her around, there are lights and sounds. There is also a clip where you can spin her around. Three LR44 batteries are required and are included.

This is the “Galaxy Friend” doll. You can purchase her without the hoverboard as well.

[[ASIN:B01AT5MN0U Barbie Star Light Adventure Galaxy Friend Doll]]
text_fidelity_b: Barbie Star Light Adventure Lights & Sounds Hoverboarder

text_fidelity_a:
Barbie Spin Art Designer with Doll, Blonde This set comes in both a blonde and brunette version. The hair color also determines the skin tone of the doll.

It’s nice that no batteries are required for this dress design making kit. The spin-art maker is manually operated.

If you watch the video at the top of the listing it shows exactly how the spin-art maker works.

Each of the three dresses is washable, so you can create a design, and then wash the dress and create another. . . and another. .. and another. The pain lasts a long time, as you don’t need very much to make your “creation”.
text_fidelity_b: Barbie Spin Art Designer with Doll, Blonde

text_fidelity_a: Barbie SLA Galaxy Barbie Doll & Hover Cat If you watch the video at the top of the listing, you will see exactly how this toy works. You’ll need four AAA batteries, which are not included. . .and should have been, at this price.  It’s a cute toy, and kids love it. . . but. . . the one thing I don’t really like about it is the fact that the “leash” can not be disconnected from Barbie, so you can’t play with her like a “regular” Barbie.  This will always be a two-piece sort of set.
text_fidelity_b: Barbie SLA Galaxy Barbie Doll & Hover Cat

text_fidelity_a:
Mega Bloks Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Advent Calendar This is a very cool idea. In the end, you have lots of “extra bits” to add to all of your other Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Mega Bloks sets.

This is a kit where someone needs to purchase and set it up for the child who will be receiving it so that the child doesn’t really know what’s inside, and will be surprised each day. Otherwise, if they see the box, then it will spoil the surprise, because it shows everything. You can always keep the box for afterwards, as I think there are some cool graphics on the box.
text_fidelity_b: Mega Bloks Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Advent Calendar

text_fidelity_a:
POOF Sidewalk Chalks Beach Fun POOF makes several of these colorful sets of shaped sidewalk chalk. They are cute, but the really are not the best if you want “real” sidewalk chalk. POOF offers a pack of sixty pieces of assorted colored sidewalk chalk which is a much more affordable option and also works better because it’s “real”, round, sidewalk chalk. Lots more vibrant colors. This “Beach Fun” set is cute. . . but just not practical.

[[ASIN:B007NLFWZW POOF 60pc. Sidewalk Chalk]]
text_fidelity_b: POOF Sidewalk Chalks Beach Fun

text_fidelity_a:
Hasbro Gaming Pie Face Showdown Game Double the fun with the Pie Face Showdown game. If you know the original Pie Face game, then you know that each person took a turn, so it was one-at-a-time. With this new version, two people play at the same time, to make it more exciting . . . fun. . . .and funny.

Don’t forget to purchase some whipped cream. Also you might want to wear tee-shirts. It’s just easier clean-up wise. I wish there was something “more” to the game, like questions / answers and not just who can press their button fastest. . . but. . . it’s still fun.
text_fidelity_b: Hasbro Gaming Pie Face Showdown Game

text_fidelity_a: K’NEX Mighty Makers – World Travels Building Set – 403 Pieces – Ages 7+ Constructional Education Toy I like this set a lot.  It’s one of the large “Mighty Makers” sets for girls, at 403 pieces.  You can create thirteen different structures from around the world.  Note that instruction for seven are included with the kit, and you’ll need to go to the K’NEX website for instructions for the additional six.  It’s great not only for the building aspect of it, but also for the geographical part too!  Hopefully it will stir your child to learn more about these places around the world.  I like the fact that with this kit you can build one or two of the items, and then take a break.  It makes the enjoyment of the kit last longer.
text_fidelity_b: K’NEX Mighty Makers – World Travels Building Set – 403 Pieces – Ages 7+ Constructional Education Toy

text_fidelity_a: Alex Spa My Lites Custom Streaks Girls Fashion Activity If you’re expecting color like you see in the pictures on the box. . . then that’s probably not going to happen.  But this hair chalk will give you some light color to your hair.  I think it works best on very light / blonde hair.  This kit is more of a kids afternoon fun sort of thing.  There is not a lot of chalk included, so it’s not going to last too long either, which can also depend upon the length of hair. If you don’t like it, you can always wash it out.
text_fidelity_b: Alex Spa My Lites Custom Streaks Girls Fashion Activity

text_fidelity_a:
Hot Wheels Hot Wheels Versus Track Set [Amazon Exclusive] This is kind of “odd” to me. A Hot Wheels set specifically made to crash cars. But that’s indeed what it is.

Though you can use any cars you want to destroy. . . . There are two cars included, which are specifically made for “crashing” because you can attach things to the included cars like Lego pieces and “customize” your crashes.

If you want, you can also record the crashes with a phone or tablet.
text_fidelity_b: Hot Wheels Hot Wheels Versus Track Set [Amazon Exclusive]

text_fidelity_a: Franklin Sports Hoop to Go Basketball Set I have yet to come across a basketball set of this style which works well. . . .and that goes for this one as well.  Assembly is required.  Three AAA batteries are also required, and not included.  They should have included foam basketballs, instead of the rally cheap blow-up ones that are inside.  There is a hook for the door, but it may not work.  It didn’t work for mine.  Overall it’s a very cheap set. .  .but it’s also not very expensive.  Of course it’s Made in China.
text_fidelity_b: Franklin Sports Hoop to Go Basketball Set

text_fidelity_a: Hyper Toss Action Game I first heard about and played this game at an Independence Day party at a friend’s house. One of the people there had bought it for their 10 year old son’s birthday. I was really bad at it (of course I had had no practice), but I thoroughly enjoyed playing it. It was definitely a coordination/mind game.  Two AA batteries are required, and included.  There are four game modes, so it’s not just a “one-trick-pony” game.
text_fidelity_b: Hyper Toss Action Game

text_fidelity_a:
Transformers Rescue Bots Headquarters Playset Though this is part of the “Transformers” series of toys, it does not come with any Transformer figures. You’ll need to add your own. It does come with one “Cody Burns” figure.

The “Vehicle Launcher” will launch the included motorcycle forward. The launcher can be attached to several different places on the firehouse, or you can also use it separately.

There are lots of doors / compartments on the firehouse, as well as other moving pieces.

The “projectile launchers” are use to launch the two included “projectiles”. The “projectiles” look like splashes of water. . . at least to me. It would have been nice if more of these were included. I don’t see that more can be purchased separately.

Overall it’s a nice large set.
text_fidelity_b: Transformers Rescue Bots Headquarters Playset

text_fidelity_a: Chutes and Ladders Board Game for 2 to 4 Players Kids Ages 3 and Up (Amazon Exclusive) This is an updated version of a game from years-gone-by.  It’s great that it’s Made in the USA. . . and at the current price of under ten bucks, it’s affordable.  It’s fun and easy to play.  I like the new, updated version which is more “modern” and colorful than the original.  It’s for two – four players.  Great for both kids and adults to play together.  Great for learning numbers from one to one-hundred.  It also doesn’t take a lot of time to play, so kids don’t get bored.
text_fidelity_b: Chutes and Ladders Board Game for 2 to 4 Players Kids Ages 3 and Up (Amazon Exclusive)

text_fidelity_a: Twister Ultimate: Bigger Mat, More Colored Spots, Family, Kids Party Game Age 6+; Compatible with Alexa (Amazon Exclusive) This is. .. more-or-less.  .just like the “classic” twister game. . . except that it’s larger.  So the thought is that more people can play.  The mat is 64” X 93” so you’ll need to make sure you have enough room.  Granted, you can fold the mat to make it smaller, but then fewer people will be able to play.  As to exactly how many can play. . . Well I certainly don’t think more than six or eight.  If each person has four appendages which need to be placed on a colored spot, then you’re going to run out of spots if you have too many people.
text_fidelity_b: Twister Ultimate: Bigger Mat, More Colored Spots, Family, Kids Party Game Age 6+; Compatible with Alexa (Amazon Exclusive)

text_fidelity_a:
Celebrity Name Game The timer needs three AAA batteries, which are not included.

This game requires at least four players.

This is the type of game which will be popular with fans of pop culture. It’s a simple enough game. It’s produced by a company by the name of PlayMonster. If you go to their website you can see all of the rules. PlayMonster makes lots of different games. I think you can certainly add categories of your own. . or. . add names to the categories on the cards. It’s up to you.

At the current price of twenty bucks, it’s also affordable. It’s a great game for older kids as well as adults. Works well for game night.
text_fidelity_b: Celebrity Name Game

text_fidelity_a: The Secret Life of Pets Shrinky Dinks Activity Set If you’re not familiar with “Shrinky Dinks”, they are super easy.  You just color. .  and bake.  I find that a toaster oven works really well, but a “regular” oven will also work.  Obviously adult supervision is required when it comes to the baking of the “Shrinky Dinks”.  A large number of these sets are offered.  This one, of course, is from the hit movie The Secret Life of Pets.  There are 17 “Shrinky Dinks” included.  Six colored pencils are included, but you may wish to use some additional colored pencils of your own, if you have them.
text_fidelity_b: The Secret Life of Pets Shrinky Dinks Activity Set

text_fidelity_a:
Green Toys Mixed-Up Trucks with Baxter, Rosie & Gus Book This book. .. oddly enough. . . has nothing to do with “Mixed-Up Trucks”. It has everything to do with three inept dogs. The story is really “goofy”. Three dogs have no idea what they are doing. . .then finally decide to do the job they way they were supposed to. I’m really not a fan of this story.

On top of this. . . one “assumes” that one of the dogs (Rosie) is female. But all the dogs look “generic” and male. One would have thought if Rosie was female that she would have had a pink outfit. . or a bow . . .or at least something to show that she’s female. But that’s not the case.

Believe me. . . I “get” that this is a kids book, and it’s more about the artwork than the story and so on. . . but still. . . It could have been better. It’s also expensive.
text_fidelity_b: Green Toys Mixed-Up Trucks with Baxter, Rosie & Gus Book

text_fidelity_a:
Green Toys Train Off The Rails with Kody & Dot Book - Play and Learning Storybook for Kids. Recycled Materials, Made in USA. Two-Bears Delivery Service is boring and the same each day. . . until. . . they train jumps the track, and these two bears decide to explore. Then they see where all of the packages they carry go. The story is ok. . .but of course trains that run on tracks can’t simply go off the track and run around! Hahahaha

This book is expensive. . . but. . .it’s printed in the USA with soy ink on 100% recycled paper, so you’re going to pay a little more. The artwork is nice and colorful.
text_fidelity_b: Green Toys Train Off The Rails with Kody & Dot Book - Play and Learning Storybook for Kids. Recycled Materials, Made in USA.

text_fidelity_a: Mega Bloks Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Sewer Lair Building Kit This is a nice . . large (342-piece) set.  It comes with thee characters. . . . Leo. .  .Tiger Claw. . . Foot Soldier.  It’s multi-level and has a lot going on.  Hours of fun . . . not only putting it together, but also playing with it.  Mega Bloks makes a lot of smaller sets which compliment this one.  . but. . . this is one of the larger sets.  Of course with all such Mega Bloks sets.  . .there are tons of little pieces, so not for kids under 5.
text_fidelity_b: Mega Bloks Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Sewer Lair Building Kit

text_fidelity_a:
Green Toys Boats Built for Speed with Davey & Pearl - Play and Learning Storybook for Kids. Recycled Materials, Made in USA. This is a colorful book. I’m not a huge fan of the story, though I don’t know if small kids will really care. One duck is reckless. .. One is less so. In the end, I think the story should have ended with the ducks building more boats. . . and employing more of their duck friends. . . instead of building speedboats. It would have been a MUCH better ending “my way”.

There are quite a few “big words” in this book which will take time to explain. That’s not a bad thing. . . just a comment.

I like that it’s printed in the USA with soy ink on recycled paper. .. but I still think at fifteen bucks, it’s quite expensive.
text_fidelity_b: Green Toys Boats Built for Speed with Davey & Pearl - Play and Learning Storybook for Kids. Recycled Materials, Made in USA.

text_fidelity_a:
Lil Lockitz Best Friend Party Pack ALEX Toys makes a huge number of these sets. Most of them have a “theme” to them. This particular set is the “Best Friend Party Pack” which has 18 “Lockitz” and is geared for birthday parties, sleepovers, etc.

If you’re not familiar with “Lockitz” you simply put “trinkets” into a round container and then use it as a necklace, bracelet, etc. The “trinkets” just shake around inside. It’s impossible to see what’s there, unless you look really close, plus you have to shake the “Lockitz” to spread things out.

The one thing which is included with this kit is the “Photo Puncher”. This is the best item of the entire kit. So even though you’ll never really see the “trinkets” in the “Lockitz”.. . . . At least you’ll see the picture, unless you overload the “Lockitz” with “trinkets”. But being able to add a picture makes it work.

At the current price of forty bucks for lots of Made in China plastic. . It’s quite expensive.
text_fidelity_b: Lil Lockitz Best Friend Party Pack

text_fidelity_a: My Mini MixieQ’s Neon Arcade Deluxe Playset This is a HUGE “No” for me.  First of all, the packaging is awful.  There’s just clear plastic with a tiny bit of glue around the edge stuck to cardboard.  Part of the edge was unglued, and pieces were falling out.  The pieces are tiny. .  .miniscule. . . almost microscopic.  I don’t know how else to say very. .  .very . .  .small.  You can hardly even see them. . . How are you supposed to play with them?  You’ll need tweezers.  If you drop a piece on the floor, you’ll never find it.  I can’t believe that they show 4 as a starting age for this item.  If you give this to a four-year-old, you’re going to be in trouble.  This is not an item which should be on the market.
text_fidelity_b: My Mini MixieQ’s Neon Arcade Deluxe Playset

text_fidelity_a: Mega Bloks Monster High School Fang Out School Play Set with Draculaura and Elissabat Dolls There are 337 pieces to this set.  This is one of several Mega Bloks Monster High sets which are offered, but I think this is probably the largest.  I like all of the “scrolling” design work.  This set shows that it’s for ages eight and up, but if you’re not familiar with Mega Bloks sets, there are a lot of small pieces, so be careful if smaller kids are around.  This set is very colorful and I like that a couple of characters are included as well.
text_fidelity_b: Mega Bloks Monster High School Fang Out School Play Set with Draculaura and Elissabat Dolls

text_fidelity_a:
Craft-tastic Paper Bowls — DIY Bowl-Making Paper Craft Kit — Makes 3 Different Sizes — For Kids Ages 8+ When you take into consideration that you make three bowls from one kit (all different sizes) this is a nice kit overall.

The “trick” I used was to lay some circles out on plastic wrap and used a sprayer bottle to spray them lightly with water. . . then turned them over and did the same on the other side. Waited a few minutes, and this made them more pliable.

This is the type of craft that takes a lot of patience. It’s certainly not for everyone, but the end result is nice.
text_fidelity_b: Craft-tastic Paper Bowls — DIY Bowl-Making Paper Craft Kit — Makes 3 Different Sizes — For Kids Ages 8+

text_fidelity_a:
Mega Construx Kubros T-800 Guardian This kit goes well with the T-800 building Kit. There are 158 pieces to this kit. Though the “Kubros” guys are not very large, there are still lots of small pieces to each of them. Might be a bit tedious for some. But once you get started and finish one, you kind of get “hooked” and want some more. They all have an interesting “square-head” look to them. You can play with them, or just have them on display.

[[ASIN:B01D8S8JSA Mega Bloks Kubros Terminator T-800 Building Kit (1 Piece)]]
text_fidelity_b: Mega Construx Kubros T-800 Guardian

text_fidelity_a: Mega Construx Kubros Assassin's Creed Ezio Building Kit Mega Bloks makes a variety of these little guys from different games / TV Shows / Movies / etc.  This one has 148 pieces, so even though they are small, there are still quite a lot of pieces.  They are for ages ten and up.  You’ll have to be careful if you have smaller kids around, due to all of the little pieces.  They are cool with their square features.  It’s fun to have a collection of different guys.
text_fidelity_b: Mega Construx Kubros Assassin's Creed Ezio Building Kit

text_fidelity_a:
Mega Bloks Call of Duty Desert Tank Building Set This is a VERY large construction set, with 848 pieces. It shows on the box that it’s for 14+. I think it can depend upon the person, and it could be a nice parent/child project to work on. It’s certainly a fun project for adults too! Of course with this many pieces, you need a fairly large workspace. You’ll also need to be careful if there are younger kids in the house, due to all the small pieces.

The “end result” is very cool. You can tell by the pictures just how detailed this vehicle is. I really like all of the Mega Bloks Call of Duty kits, and there are several.
text_fidelity_b: Mega Bloks Call of Duty Desert Tank Building Set

text_fidelity_a:
Seedling Create a Dazzling Tiara This Made in New Zealand Tiara Kit is really cute. There are lots of included babbles and items to create a quite fancy tiara. Kids will have a lot of fun designing their tiara.

I will say that I wish the “band” for the tiara were a bit larger, and more sturdy. I also wish that two bands were included, as there’s enough “stuff” inside to make at least two tiaras.

Seedling offers lots and lots of such craft kits for kids. Their packaging is really . . . really . . . nice. Very colorful, and not just a boring “generic” box. Great for giving as gifts.
text_fidelity_b: Seedling Create a Dazzling Tiara

text_fidelity_a:
Seedling Design Your Own Superhero Mask Dress Up Activity Kit This Made in New Zealand . . . . do-it-yourself. . . . Superhero Mask is a fun craft project for kids. Everything you need is included in the kit. Honestly, for some pieces of precut felt and such, it’s a bit expensive for twenty bucks. . . but. . . it’s indeed a fun, colorful project. The packaging from Seedling is really great as well. Seedling makes a variety of such do-it-yourself craft projects for kids. Younger kids will certainly need adult supervision. You’ll also want to plan-out your design first before using glue.

This Superhero Mask also goes well with the Superhero Cape. . . link below. . . .

[[ASIN:B017O4UYT6 Seedling Design Your Own Superhero Cape]]
text_fidelity_b: Seedling Design Your Own Superhero Mask Dress Up Activity Kit

text_fidelity_a: My Little Pony Wonderbolts Applejack Doll I got this for my granddaughter because she is a huge “My Little Pony” fan.  This toy is no exception. I like the fact that the tail and mane are part of the rest of the pony.  My granddaughter will brush or comb the ones with nylon hair and it gets all over the bathtub or wherever she is playing. The legs on this toy are movable and overall well-constructed. The colors are great goes well from the play room to bath time.
text_fidelity_b: My Little Pony Wonderbolts Applejack Doll

text_fidelity_a: Hasbro Gaming Cranium Dark Game This game is edgy enough for young adults to play but still not too vulgar for older parents.  I would not suggest this game for children because it does have some “adult themes” that would not be appropriate for children. I found that the more we played the funnier it was. It is simple to play but still requires some thought. I would recommend this game for small group of friends or something fun to do after a dinner part.
text_fidelity_b: Hasbro Gaming Cranium Dark Game

text_fidelity_a:
Adora Baby Bath Toy Kitty, 13 inch Bath Time Doll with QuickDri Body Let them take their dolly into the water! This is a great doll for younger babies although it is suggested for 12+ months. Babies love touching and playing with the doll’s little hands. The doll comes wearing a swimsuit and an adorable kitten hooded towel. Other accessories can be purchases separately, like a bottle. She has a soft body, but it is made of a material that dries quickly and is machine washable. The swimsuit cannot be removed, but the towel can. Overall this is a great doll for a variety of ages, even up to 7 or so. Be sure to let the doll dry out to keep mold from growing.

A note about the complexion of the doll. I think the company is trying to be all things to all people. By that I mean that this doll has a “medium complexion”.
text_fidelity_b: Adora Baby Bath Toy Kitty, 13 inch Bath Time Doll with QuickDri Body

text_fidelity_a: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Let's Get Ready Sink Such a fun, cute, and interactive toy for our little gal! The toy includes a pretend sink, mirror and counter along with accessories like a soap dispenser, comb, jar of toothpaste, and a toothbrush. There are 50+ sounds and songs as well as prompts and phrases for children to respond to. The soap dispenser actually pumps up and down, which is fun! There are three different modes that you can choose depending on the age and development of the child. This is a great feature that allows the toy to grow as they grow. It requires batteries and they are included, which is a huge plus!
text_fidelity_b: Fisher-Price Laugh & Learn Let's Get Ready Sink

text_fidelity_a: Barbie Pup Pool and Diving Board Set My grandbaby is so so about the Barbie doll its self, but she really likes the swimming dog and its pup. She does like that Barbie’s bathing suit changes color when you put it in warm water.  She plays with the doll, pool, and the dogs in the bath.  Her favorite thing is the swimming dog. The tail is used to wind the dog up and his front feet move back and forth while the tail spins briefly. The dog cannot swim straight up and falls over in the water. The good news is, my granddaughter does not care that the dog swims on its side. There is a pup that fits on the dogs back but does not help the swimming situation. Overall she enjoys playing with this set in her own bath and keeps her busy for plenty of soak time.
text_fidelity_b: Barbie Pup Pool and Diving Board Set

text_fidelity_a: Disney Descendants Neon Lights Feature Evie of Isle of the Lost She is absolutely gorgeous doll.  This is a high quality doll with an outfit that is also of great quality.  Her blue hair and the face is that of an angel.  The boots are rocking!  The details in this doll and her clothes are superior.  At the current price of twenty-nine bucks for a Made in China doll, she is a little expensive, but the styling is really great, and I still lover her.  She is a little larger than a Barbie doll, but has a trendier look.
text_fidelity_b: Disney Descendants Neon Lights Feature Evie of Isle of the Lost

text_fidelity_a: The Secret Life of Pets 3D Fabric Max This is a fun craft project as long as you do not expect it to look exactly like Max. It comes with a Styrofoam head and material that is supposed to be pushed into the head.  It has eyes and ears that you push in also.  The main “problem” with this project is the time it takes.  It takes a long. . . Long. . .LONG time to press all of it into the Styrofoam.  If you divide-up the time and do it over a few sittings, then that’s one thing. . . but. . . otherwise it might never get finished.  If you have a child that loves arts and crafts this would be a fun entertaining thing to do, but otherwise I would not suggest it.
text_fidelity_b: The Secret Life of Pets 3D Fabric Max

text_fidelity_a:
Disney Cars Toys Flag Finish Lightning McQueen Anyone who likes the movie “Cars” (and who doesn’t). . .. Is going to enjoy this toy. . . . BUT. . . It’s going to eat you out of house-and-home in batteries. It requires SIX (6) AA batteries and TWO (2) AAA batteries.

You’re going to have to have a lot of (flat) space for this vehicle. You’ll either have to have a large. . . empty. . . basement or garage. . . or. . . use it outside in a large area. There’s no sensor to keep it from crashing into things. . . So a small inside space isn’t going to work.

The flag idea is a novel one. It works relatively well, and kids enjoy it.
text_fidelity_b: Disney Cars Toys Flag Finish Lightning McQueen

text_fidelity_a:
Bright Starts Pop & Giggle Pond Pal Ball Popper Musical Toy, Ages 6 months + First of all, 4 AA batteries are NOT included. That’s something which should have been included, especially at the current cost.

This is a very simple toy. But there are lights. . . and sounds. . . so it keeps kids engaged. If you watch the video at the top, you’ll see exactly how it works. You have to keep pressing buttons to keep it going.

Personally, I think six balls is the right number, but if you would like to purchase more, they are offered.

[[ASIN:B008PPQ7GI Bright Starts Having A Ball Toys, Bunch of Balls]]
text_fidelity_b: Bright Starts Pop & Giggle Pond Pal Ball Popper Musical Toy, Ages 6 months +

text_fidelity_a: My Little Pony Equestria Girls Canterlot High Dance Playset Kids will LOVE interacting with the Twilight Sparkle doll and dressing her up. The stage is easy to assemble and simply snaps together. The toy comes with several accessories (24 to be exact) that helped kids to interact and use their imagination! The music is great too, so being able to use the pretend DJ booth was icing on the cake! The toy also comes with a rotating stage that you hook the dolls into so they can stand up. Keep in mind this toy has small pieces that are choking hazards for children under 3.
text_fidelity_b: My Little Pony Equestria Girls Canterlot High Dance Playset

text_fidelity_a: Franklin Sports VIBE Kids Sports + Playground Balls - Indoor + Outdoor Kids Basketball, Soccer Ball, Volleyball + Playground Balls - Rainbow Mini Sports Balls for Kids I have three of these balls.  . Playground Ball.  .. . Soccer Ball. . .  .Spike Ball.  They are all made of the same material which is kind of rubbery.  They are all super colorful.  But they are all cheap (thought not necessarily inexpensive) balls.  The soccer ball, for example, is not a “real” soccer ball.  It’s simply a ball painted to look similar to a soccer ball.  They are all slightly underinflated.  If you’re looking for an inexpensive “generic” ball, there are better options out there.  If you’re looking for a “real” basketball or soccer ball, then I would recommend buying the “real” thing.  But these balls are certainly colorful.
text_fidelity_b: Franklin Sports VIBE Kids Sports + Playground Balls - Indoor + Outdoor Kids Basketball, Soccer Ball, Volleyball + Playground Balls - Rainbow Mini Sports Balls for Kids

text_fidelity_a: Adora Mixxie Pony 15" Plush and Interchangeable Parts Including Unicorn Headband/Tutu/Necklace This is an absolutely adorable pony/doll combination. The colors are bright, cheerful, and creative. It is soft and lovable like a baby doll, but looks like a horse.  The legs are supposed to be interchangeable, but my daughter could not unbutton the legs.  She gave it to me to help her and I could not unbutton them either.  The other items, such as the TuTu, headband, necklace and other accessories are easy to get on and off. Overall, this is quality, fun doll and based on our experience would recommend it to others.
text_fidelity_b: Adora Mixxie Pony 15" Plush and Interchangeable Parts Including Unicorn Headband/Tutu/Necklace

text_fidelity_a: Disney Frozen Small Doll Feature Playset I don’t know who is more excited about this toy, me or my granddaughter.  She loves the movie Frozen and this was a big deal for her.  My grandbaby loves to watch the castle rise up and down and also loves the characters, Elsa and Olaf.  Elsa has an extra dress and there are many other extras to add to her clothes and hair. My grandchild is 4, but I still worry about all the very small pieces that could become a choking hazard and would not recommend allowing a child 4 or under to play with this toy by themselves.
text_fidelity_b: Disney Frozen Small Doll Feature Playset

text_fidelity_a:
Toy State Caterpillar CAT Apprentice Tower Crane With Fork Lift Construction Vehicle Playset This set comes in a rather large, plastic “workman’s box”. There are 420 pieces, so you’ll need to allow time and space to put it together. The screws are rather small, which is ok for kids. . . not-so-much for adults, especially because there are so many of them.

As you can tell by the picture, this is a very top-heavy crane. I wish the base was weighted. I also wish there were two screwdrivers included, so that two could work on it at the same time.
text_fidelity_b: Toy State Caterpillar CAT Apprentice Tower Crane With Fork Lift Construction Vehicle Playset

text_fidelity_a:
Fisher Price Grow to Pro Triple Hit Baseball This machine is trying to be three things, which it should only be two. You’ll probably want to use a different tee. But the second mode, where it pops the ball up . .. and the third mode, where it actually pitches, both work great! For the price, you really can’t beat it. The only thing I wish it had were more balls included. .. but. . . you can purchase additional balls, so that works. See link below.

[[ASIN:B002EAMJDK Fisher-Price Triple Hit Foam Baseball - (3pk) Replacement Balls]]
text_fidelity_b: Fisher Price Grow to Pro Triple Hit Baseball

text_fidelity_a:
Spin & Sparkle Pet Maker This is a project where adult supervision is certainly required. There’s a lot going on. . . and lots of bits-and-pieces. . . so don’t even think about starting this without an adult. It also takes some patience. Once you place the casting mix in the mold. . . and turn it around and around for several minutes. .. . It will be at least 30-minutes until you can unmold and start the painting / decorating of your pet.

Overall it’s a nice craft kit. The one thing I wish RoseArt offered were additional cast powder packets. The only way I see to get additional packets is to purchase additional “pets”.
text_fidelity_b: Spin & Sparkle Pet Maker

text_fidelity_a: Fisher-Price Nickelodeon Shimmer & Shine, Wish & Spin, Shine This doll is cute. . .  but. . . .  She tends to tip-over on a regular basis.  It’s also a bit loud (wish there were volume control).  She is pretty though and her jewels light-up.  Four AAA batteries are required and included.  I really like the other Shimmer and Shine dolls that Fisher-Price offers, which are not electronic, as they can be carried around anywhere and I think they are actually more fun to play with than this doll.  This one is fun, for a bit, but she is more for show to watch and not really play with.
text_fidelity_b: Fisher-Price Nickelodeon Shimmer & Shine, Wish & Spin, Shine

text_fidelity_a: Fisher-Price Smart Scan Word Dash This wand / game is fun to start, but there really should be more discs, even if they were to be sold separately.  Because of that, it kind of gets old rather quickly.  The “scanner” can be a bit temperamental, to say the least.  Sometimes you have to press buttons. . . sometimes you don’t. . .  .I think the company started-off in the right direction with this item, but I just don’t think they executed completely. It would be nice if they had an “updated” version with more discs. .  easier control. .  .more learning.
text_fidelity_b: Fisher-Price Smart Scan Word Dash

text_fidelity_a:
Baby Alive Baby Go Bye Bye (African American) This doll requires four AA batteries, which are included. . . but of course you’ll want to stock-up on more.

It’s a very cute, and rather large doll. It comes in a really nice box, ready to be wrapped and given to that special little girl.

If your child wants to continue to feed the doll and change diapers, then you’re going to have to stock-up on diapers. Only one is included. Additional diapers are offered (see link below) but they are expensive. “Pretending” to feed the baby may be a better (and less costly) option.

[[ASIN:B00MY46RNY Baby Alive Diapers Pack]]
text_fidelity_b: Baby Alive Baby Go Bye Bye (African American)

text_fidelity_a:
Lil Lockitz Selfie Set This company makes an enormous number of these sets. This particular set is “special” because it includes a “Photo Puncher” so that you can place a photo inside your “Lockitz”. That’s certainly a nice feature, but this set also only makes two “lockitz”.

At the current price of twenty bucks (that’s ten bucks per “Lockitz”) for Made in China, that certainly reaches the level of crazy expensive. Fortunately, you can use the “Photo Puncher” for other “Lockitz” sets as well. There are other sets with more “Lockitz” included, at a lower price, but they don’t include the “Photo Puncher”.
text_fidelity_b: Lil Lockitz Selfie Set

text_fidelity_a: Sesame Street Playskool Discover ABCs with Elmo Playset A fun and interactive way to help children learn and recognize their ABCs! Let them learn with their favorite pal, Elmo, as they walk through Sesame Street and uncover hidden letters. Included in the set is a scene from Sesame Street and an Elmo character to play with. Elmo has a special red lens in his hand to help them discover what is hidden in Sesame Street! This item is best used with one child as there is only one Elmo character. Discover ABC’s playset can also connect with Cookie Monster Playset for an even more fun experience!
text_fidelity_b: Sesame Street Playskool Discover ABCs with Elmo Playset

text_fidelity_a: Play-Doh Cake Party Dough Play Set The PlayDoh Cake Party is a fun and hands on toy for children who love to build and create! In the box is all the tools needed to create a colorful cake or cupcake including five jars of Play-Doh, cookie molds, an icing tool and more. Children can shape pretend cakes with the “oven” or with cutters then decorate with icing and other cut out shapes including sea shells, hearts, stars and more. The confetti play-doh adds a pop of color that kids love! The set also includes plates, knives, and a spatula to create a more realistic experience. This toy is ideal for children over the age of 3 who can understand not to eat the play-doh. Definitely kid approved!
text_fidelity_b: Play-Doh Cake Party Dough Play Set

text_fidelity_a: POOF Sidewalk Chalks Glow Chalk I couldn’t wait for my granddaughter to visit me so that we could draw on the driveway and then check it out after dark. Nothing! Do not waste your money on this product.  It does not glow in the dark, it’s expensive for chalk, and it stinks! (smells bad) I endured the smell in hopes of seeing my grandbaby’s chalk art glow in the dark, but it was total disappointment.  I am very sensitive to smells and my money would be better spent on regular white colored chalk.
text_fidelity_b: POOF Sidewalk Chalks Glow Chalk

text_fidelity_a:
FSI Steel Bounce Game At the current price of sixty bucks for a very cheap Made in China game, it’s just not working for me.
.
The frame is very lightweight to the point of being rickety. The net was not attached correctly, and even when I reattached, it wasn’t taunt enough to get much bounce off of it.

The storage bag is almost laughable.

On top of everything else, it’s really not much fun to play. There are much better games out there, at much better prices.
text_fidelity_b: FSI Steel Bounce Game

text_fidelity_a: Play-Doh Town 3-in-1 Town Center Play-Doh Town is a lot of fun for parent/child or grandparent/child playtime.  This is not a toy that you can leave a 3 year old to play with alone.  There is quite a bit of assembly required and does not unsnap easily after you finish playing.  There are a lot of pieces and some are very small and could easily end up in a child’s mouth.  I would recommend supervision at all times while playing with this.  I do like the 8 small Play-Doh containers and different colors and all of the different shapes that can be made with the presses.  My granddaughter is almost 4 and loves to play all of the little pieces, but it is quite a mess to clean up.
text_fidelity_b: Play-Doh Town 3-in-1 Town Center

text_fidelity_a: My Little Pony Explore Equestria Baby Flurry Heart Doll My 3 year old granddaughter loves anything having to do with My Little Pony and loves all of the smaller figures.  It is nice to have something large enough to sit on her bed. The Baby Flurry Heart is a cross between a stuffed animal and a doll.  She loves the soft tummy and holding it, plus she makes the horn light up all the time.  I find the sound of its voice a little annoying, but more importantly my granddaughter likes the way it sounds.  She holds it while watching My Little Pony and it has become one of her favorite toys.
text_fidelity_b: My Little Pony Explore Equestria Baby Flurry Heart Doll

text_fidelity_a:
Alex Art Wooden Dough Tools Set Kids Art and Craft Activity Note that the “dough” is not included with this set. ALEX offers their own “dough” (see below) but you can use any brand you like.

I like that these tools are wooden. They have a nice “heavy” feel to them, as opposed to plastic. But I must say that they are not put together that great. More effort could have been used on attaching the handles. The one tool I think the set is missing is a “flat” rolling pin. But these are lots of fun to play with.

[[ASIN:B000BN8XSW ALEX Toys Artist Studio Dough in Basic Colors]]
text_fidelity_b: Alex Art Wooden Dough Tools Set Kids Art and Craft Activity

text_fidelity_a: K'NEX – Beasts Alive Robo-Jaws Building Set – 136 Parts – Ages 7+ – Engineering Educational Toy I like this set for several reasons.  First, it’s not that large.  It’s 130-pieces, so it’s a “reasonable” size.  It has a motor, so it moves. . . though I must say I wish they had also included the required 2 AA batteries, and they didn’t.  You can build three different “creations” from this set.  For kids. . . teens. . .and even adults who like to build, this is a great “starter” sort of kit.  Once you’ve mastered this one, you’ll have an idea of if you want to continue with larger sets.
text_fidelity_b: K'NEX – Beasts Alive Robo-Jaws Building Set – 136 Parts – Ages 7+ – Engineering Educational Toy

text_fidelity_a: The Secret Life of Pets 3D Fabric Snowball This is a very simple craft item..  .but. . .some kids might find it monotonous.  For the most part, you simply poke pieces of fabric into the Styrofoam mold with an included tool.  But there are lots. . .and Lots. . . and LOTS of pieces of fabric.  Obviously, patience is required.  If not completed in the first sitting, you can always go back to it until it’s complete.  But once it’s complete, it’s a cute decorative item for a shelf.
text_fidelity_b: The Secret Life of Pets 3D Fabric Snowball

text_fidelity_a: Star Wars Galactic Heroes The Ghost This is a nice, large set.  The box itself is 15 X 12 X 4”.  Two small figures are also included.  Additional figures are sold separately.  Currently a picture of the back of the box is not posted, so I’m going to submit one.  There is a lot more detail on the back, so you can see just exactly what is possible with this set.  There is a lot going on here!  If you’re a Star Wars fan, then this is certainly a nice item to have.
text_fidelity_b: Star Wars Galactic Heroes The Ghost

text_fidelity_a: K’NEX Revolution Ferris Wheel Building Set – 344 Pieces with Battery Powered Motor – Ages 7+ Engineering Education Toy This is a cook construction toy.  It’s not that many pieces. . . and not that difficult to put together.  This is one of several Amusement Park sets which K’Nex Offers.  They are all pretty cool.  So if you have the space, you can create an entire park.  This kit requires two AA batteries, which are not included.  This is a good “starter” kit for kids before they move onto more challenging kits.  I wish K’Nex would offer video instructions.  That would really seal-the-deal.
text_fidelity_b: K’NEX Revolution Ferris Wheel Building Set – 344 Pieces with Battery Powered Motor – Ages 7+ Engineering Education Toy

text_fidelity_a: My Little Pony Friendship Is Magic Celestia Doll For molded plastic Made in China, I think the current price of twenty bucks is quite high.  Having said that, it is a nice piece.  I think it looks a little better in person than in the pictures online.  Princess Celestia stands 8” high.  I would say the sculpture is about 7” across.  If you’re a collector, then this is certainly a nice piece to have.
text_fidelity_b: My Little Pony Friendship Is Magic Celestia Doll

text_fidelity_a: Mega Bloks TMNT Collectors Krang's Rampage Building Kit If you look at the front of the box, you’ll see this set has 305 pieces.  There’s a lot to put together, so you’ll want to make sure  you’re ready for it.  But everything is sorted nicely, so as long as you have a bit of space. . . and time. . . Note that this is not Legos.  It’s a little more “complicated” than Legos, but again for the 10-15 age-group (or higher) then it shouldn’t be an issue.  Overall it’s a cool set, and fun to build and play with.
text_fidelity_b: Mega Bloks TMNT Collectors Krang's Rampage Building Kit

text_fidelity_a: Monster High Ghoul-to-Bat Transformation Draculaura Doll The “big thing” about his doll are her wings.  The video at the top of the listing will show you how they work.  If pink is your color, then this is your doll.  The one thing that this doll is really missing is a way to stand. When the wings are expanded, there really needs to be a way for her to stand, and that’s not possible.  But I do like the way the wings expand.
text_fidelity_b: Monster High Ghoul-to-Bat Transformation Draculaura Doll

text_fidelity_a: Ever After High Ashlynn Ella 2-in-1 Magical Fashion Doll If you watch the video at the top of the posting, you’ll see what this doll is all about. She goes from a teenager to a princess, with the push-of-a-button.  I think the dress is quite pretty.  I hate the shoes.  Why toy companies may such shows for dolls is beyond me.  They look like hooker shoes to me.  The packaging is also not great and was “mashed” when I received the doll.  But as for the doll herself, I like her just fine.
text_fidelity_b: Ever After High Ashlynn Ella 2-in-1 Magical Fashion Doll

text_fidelity_a: The Secret Life of Pets Scra-ffiti Pad These are fun “doodle books”.  They come in a great variety.  If you do a search for Scra-ffiti, you’ll find them all.  All you have to do is use the included wooden stick to “scratch” across the picture to color them in.  Great for on-the-road. . . sitting in an office. . . and so on.  There are ten pages / pictures.  The book is 7” X 6”, not including the top part where the wooden pencil is located.
text_fidelity_b: The Secret Life of Pets Scra-ffiti Pad

text_fidelity_a: Pokmon Clip and Carry Poke Ball Belt This is a fun, albeit expensive, Pokémon item.  The set comes with one belt, two balls and one Pikachu figure.  Additional balls and figures are sold separately.  The belt can hold up to six balls.  The balls pop-open with the press of a button.  You can’t see what’s inside until you open them.  The balls can certainly hold other small items as well, like snacks.  I just think they are going a little overboard with the current price of thirty-five bucks for Made in China.
text_fidelity_b: Pokmon Clip and Carry Poke Ball Belt

text_fidelity_a:
Mega Bloks Monster High Monsterific Name Builder The kit that I have is the Monster High design.

This kit comes with a tiny version of Frankie Stein, and a few other props. There are 242 pieces. You can build your name, or Frankie’s name. You can have up to either letters, so if you have a long name, you may have to abbreviate it. If you have “leftover” pieces, you can use them with other, similar such Mega Bloks sets. At twenty bucks, it’s a bit expensive for such an item, but I like it.
text_fidelity_b: Mega Bloks Monster High Monsterific Name Builder

text_fidelity_a:
Monster High Skulltimate Science Class Playset with Doll This is the Science Class Monster High set. There are lots and lots of different sets. It’s nice that that this one comes with one doll.

This set really doesn’t have as much going on as I thought it would. Example: The frog is supposed to “hop” when you press a button. In reality is only goes up less than a quarter inch and doesn’t “hop” at all. Overall it’s more of a “look at” sort of set. But it’s still fun to play with and pretend. . .adding additional dolls of your own.
text_fidelity_b: Monster High Skulltimate Science Class Playset with Doll

text_fidelity_a:
Mattel Games Pictionary Man: Double Draw Game This is a new twist on a popular game. The two little guys add a new dimension. It’s for ages 8 and older. . . but fun for kids only as well as adults only. .. or a mix of both.

The only thing I’m not really a fan of with this are the markers. You might want to purchase some fine point dry-erase markers separately. You can get some inexpensive ones, but I prefer the Expo brand (see below).

[[ASIN:B00I8OBAOU Expo Low-Odor Dry Erase Markers, Ultra-Fine Tip, 8-Pack, Assorted Colors]]
text_fidelity_b: Mattel Games Pictionary Man: Double Draw Game

text_fidelity_a:
Thames & Kosmos Magic: Gold Edition | Playset with 150 Tricks | 96 Page Full Color Instruction Manual | 42 Props | Video Tutorials | Fun for Kids 8+ This set has SO many tricks included! It’s really a wonderful “started-kit” for any budding magician. Easy to follow instructions, with diagrams, are included. There are also videos available online. It comes in a large box 18 X 13 X 3”. You’ll want to be careful when opening, to keep things in place. It certainly takes practice (some tricks more than others) but I really like this set. It’s great fun and entertaining. Kids will really fall in love with it. Makes a great gift too.

Note that there is also a “Silver” edition (100 tricks) and an “Onyx” edition (200 tricks).
text_fidelity_b: Thames & Kosmos Magic: Gold Edition | Playset with 150 Tricks | 96 Page Full Color Instruction Manual | 42 Props | Video Tutorials | Fun for Kids 8+

text_fidelity_a:
Barbie Spin Art Designer with Doll, Brunette One thing I really like about this kit is that you can wash the dresses so that you can continue to create new designs.

You can also use a paintbrush with the paint to enhance your “creations”. Paintbrushes are not included though.

This is a manually operated item, so batteries are not required.

This set comes with one Barbie and three dresses. If you have other Barbie’s you can use them as well.

The only thing which is missing is a better variety of colors. Having said that, I think the makers probably though if they included too many colors that kids would go crazy, and end-up with black because of using too many colors.
text_fidelity_b: Barbie Spin Art Designer with Doll, Brunette

text_fidelity_a: Fisher-Price Bright Beats Learnin' Lights Dance Mat This is a bright and colorful item.  Because there are flashing lights and music / sounds, it’s a hit with little ones.  The character in the center does not move.  The mat is also quite small at 22 X 16”.  4 AA batteries are also required.  I think it helps for an adult to show the child how this works, and to get them started.  Perhaps dance with them too!  For kids who like to move-and-groove, it’s fun.
text_fidelity_b: Fisher-Price Bright Beats Learnin' Lights Dance Mat

text_fidelity_a: Nature Bound Ant Treehouse Habitat Kit with Sand, Connector Tube, Feeding Stick & Insect Instructions, One Size This is a “beginner” ant farm.  Great for kids (and some adults).  Though you’re welcome to try ants out of your yard.  .. the odds are they won’t know what to do when you put them inside.  It’s worth giving it a shot before you buy ants.  .. but. . . the ants you buy are usually the ones that work well for ant farms and like to tunnel.  FYI. . .  .You’ll want to place it somewhere where it will not be “jolted”.  If your ants start to tunnel, then you also don’t want to touch it.  The tunnels collapse very easily.  Overall, this is a nice “starter”.
text_fidelity_b: Nature Bound Ant Treehouse Habitat Kit with Sand, Connector Tube, Feeding Stick & Insect Instructions, One Size

text_fidelity_a:
Fisher-Price Double Poppin' Dino, Ball Popper Infant Toy This toy really doesn’t have that much to it. There are six different colored balls. Turn it on and it will vibrate and the balls go everywhere. You’ll be chasing balls forever. If you child is old enough and crawling / walking then they can chase them. Otherwise someone else will be chasing them. . . and that’s really all there is to it. I don’t even think it’s all that cute either. It requires 3 C batteries, which are not included.

Fisher-Price makes a different one, which is a lot cuter, and has much better reviews.

[[ASIN:B00CQHYX2G Fisher-Price Go Baby Go Poppity-Pop Musical Dino]]
text_fidelity_b: Fisher-Price Double Poppin' Dino, Ball Popper Infant Toy

text_fidelity_a:
Fisher-Price Nickelodeon Blaze & the Monster Machines, Transforming R/C Blaze This is a fun toy not only because it’s remote controlled, but because there are character phrases and sound effects. It goes from monster truck to race car and back. The “disappointing” thing about it is the steering. There is really no steering, and there really should be. But still, for a first-time remote control car, it’s still a lot of fun. It required 4 AA batteries, which are included, but you’ll need more. Add the T-Shirt to go with it, and you have a great gift!

[[ASIN:B00XHH9CQQ Blaze and the Monster Machines Boys' Short Sleeve Tee Shirt]]
text_fidelity_b: Fisher-Price Nickelodeon Blaze & the Monster Machines, Transforming R/C Blaze

text_fidelity_a: Fisher-Price 3-in-1 Sit, Stride & Ride Lion This is a very colorful and fun item.  I like that it’s not only for scooting around, but also there is some learning going on with numbers, colors and the alphabet.  It looks like the butterfly and the white circular thing on the front right were more of an “afterthought”.  It’s made of sturdy hard plastic.  Some assembly is required.  Two AA batteries are required, and included. .. . . but of course you’ll need more.  Lots of sounds. . . lights. . . it’s fun to “feed” the lion. . .  .Nice that you can both sit on it as well as use it as support to walk.
text_fidelity_b: Fisher-Price 3-in-1 Sit, Stride & Ride Lion

text_fidelity_a:
Fisher-Price Octonauts Remote Control Gup-K This is not only a remote control vehicle, but it also has pieces which can be removed to play with separately. As a simple remote controlled vehicle, it works quite well. You’ll need six AA batteries, which are not included. There is one Octonauts figure. Additional figures are sold separately. (see below) Octonauts was first a series of books which came out in 2006, and then became a TV series.

[[ASIN:B00DMAFUDM Fisher-Price Octonauts Octo-Crew 8 Figure Pack]]
text_fidelity_b: Fisher-Price Octonauts Remote Control Gup-K

text_fidelity_a: Alex Discover Learn to Dress Monkey Kids Art and Craft Activity I think this is really more of a cute monkey toy. . . and less of a learning tool, but there are a few learning possibilities.  You can remove the clothes. . . remove the shoes and socks. .  .I think the most learning with be to tie the shoes.  But overall, he’s just a friendly. . . happy. . . monkey.  The “least desirable” part are his hands / banana.  There are small Velcro “dots” on the hands, as they are supposed to stick together, but . .  .just barely.  The banana is barely glued (or possibly stitched) on, and I’m afraid it’s going to come off fairly quickly. But otherwise I like him a lot.
text_fidelity_b: Alex Discover Learn to Dress Monkey Kids Art and Craft Activity

text_fidelity_a: Alex Discover Ready, Set, School Craft Kit Kids Art and Craft Activity, Skill Building Set for Pre School Children, Learn Basic Skills to Help in School, For Ages 3 and up I would have to go through this piece-by-piece to say exactly what I think about each part.  Overall, I find it just to be “ok” and not great.  The “safety scissors” are useless.  I don’t care for the “finger crayons” and wish that “regular” crayons had been included.  I would have preferred a few different colors of dry erase markers.  At the current price of over twenty bucks for Made in China, I think it’s also quite expensive.  It will certainly keep kids busy for a bit. . . I just wish it were a little better, and less expensive.
text_fidelity_b: Alex Discover Ready, Set, School Craft Kit Kids Art and Craft Activity, Skill Building Set for Pre School Children, Learn Basic Skills to Help in School, For Ages 3 and up

text_fidelity_a:
ALEX Toys Little Hands My Tape Town This is one of the craziest ideas I’ve ever seen. Tearing off tape as a craft project. Personally, I’m really unimpressed. I guess it really depends upon the child, and if they enjoy tearing-off tape a lot. Obviously some kids like it because Alex Toys makes other such kits using tape. I’m more inclined to like the “Tape All Day” tape, because at least some of the tape has a pattern to it and is more decorative. The tape which comes with this set is all plain. So perhaps you could combine them.

[[ASIN:B00BDMNIIA ALEX Toys Little Hands Tape All Day]]
text_fidelity_b: ALEX Toys Little Hands My Tape Town

text_fidelity_a: ALEX Toys Little Hands My ABC Book Keepsake This is a really great way for kids to learn the alphabet.  I know that it’s supposed to be a  “keepsake book”, but I really think of it more as a book for learning the alphabet, or reviewing the alphabet.  If your child doesn’t know all of the alphabet yet, then it’s probably best for this to be a parent / child activity. . .  .or perhaps older sibling / younger sibling activity.  Granted, you can just let them do what they want, but to get the most learning out of it. . . by placing the correct stickers on the correct pages and such, then I think it would be best as a “joint venture”.
text_fidelity_b: ALEX Toys Little Hands My ABC Book Keepsake

text_fidelity_a: Alex Discover My Art Kids Art and Craft Activity This is an accordion folder.  You can purchase a similar folder in office supplies. .. . even for less money. . . but then it’s not going to be like this one which has the colorful artwork on the front, and the colored dividers.  It’s not super sturdy, but it serves the purpose.  As long as you’re not going to over-stuff it, or you don’t have to sort through things on a daily basis, then it should be fine.  It’s a nice option for saving all of those “treasures”!
text_fidelity_b: Alex Discover My Art Kids Art and Craft Activity

text_fidelity_a:
Skip Hop Baby Stroller Toy, Silver Lining Cloud Jitter, Cloud This stroller attachment is part of the “Silver Lining Cloud” Collection. I actually like the “Jitter Stroller Toy”, also by Skip Hop, in the same collection, a little better just because it has a little bit more going on. As fare as “noise” and such, this one just has the beads which rattle. But the rings are nice to pull on, and the moon is soft and “squishy”. The ring which attaches to the stroller looks to be well made and secure.

[[ASIN:B01HG1LA6S Skip Hop Silver Lining Cloud Jitter Stroller Toy, Multi]]
text_fidelity_b: Skip Hop Baby Stroller Toy, Silver Lining Cloud Jitter, Cloud

text_fidelity_a: ALEX Toys Let's Pretend School This is a very cute set. I really like that it folds-up so it’s easy to put everything back together and out-of-the-way.  There are a multitude of different activities.  I think it’s a great set for both parents and kids to play together.  The parents and kids can take turns being the teacher / student.  There are lots of different pieces (225 to be exact).  It’s very colorful. LOTS of learning going on with this set!!
text_fidelity_b: ALEX Toys Let's Pretend School

text_fidelity_a: ALEX Toys Little Hands One Two Tie My Shoe This is a cute idea.  Granted, you can simply use your own shoes to learn how to tie them. . . but. . . these are very colorful. As there are four of them, you can use them for multiple children.  They are foam and very lightweight, so it can be helpful for someone to hold the shoe down on the table while the child is tying the shoe.  For Made in China, they are not as affordable as I would like, but again, they are cute.
text_fidelity_b: ALEX Toys Little Hands One Two Tie My Shoe

text_fidelity_a: Alex Little Hands Farm Finger Crayons Kids Toddler Art and Craft Activity First of all, if your desire is to have crayons that you can use to color things like coloring books with. .  .. These are not it.  You’re better off with the “regular” crayons.  These are colorful. . . stackable. . . and have farm animal faces on them. . . but they are not very good for coloring.  It’s nearly impossible to use them with just a finger.  They are kind of cute to use as “finger puppets”.  But if you’re going to use them to color, then you really have to press quite hard.  Again. . . “regular” crayons are best for coloring.
text_fidelity_b: Alex Little Hands Farm Finger Crayons Kids Toddler Art and Craft Activity

text_fidelity_a: Skip Hop Baby Stroller Toy, Silver Lining Cloud Jitter, Cloud This Made in China stroller toy has four things.  The cloud itself rattles.  The gray “drop” with yellow ribbon has “crinkle paper” inside.  The star squeaks, but you have to press kind of hard.  The center white plastic piece is pulled, then the cloud vibrates.  The ring used to attach to the stroller is strong and solid.  It’s not washable, so it’s going to have a limited life. . . but. . . it’s cute for the short term.
text_fidelity_b: Skip Hop Baby Stroller Toy, Silver Lining Cloud Jitter, Cloud

text_fidelity_a: Alex Art Paintbrush Set 50 Brushes Kids Art Supplies This is an assortment of both bristle brushes and foam brushes.  These are obviously “beginner” types of brushes.  There are not only a variety of sizes, but also different handles.  Really quite a variety.  Having said that. . .  These are what I would call “disposable” brushes.  I doubt that you’ll use them more than once.  They are simply not of the quality that they are going to hold together or last.  But they have already come in handy.
text_fidelity_b: Alex Art Paintbrush Set 50 Brushes Kids Art Supplies

text_fidelity_a: Creativity for Kids Spark!Lab Smithsonian Invent Super Shoes Coloring Kit This is the “shoes” version of Spark!Lab kits.  Each of their kits offer a little something different.  Some are more about building things.  This one is more about designing shoes / boots.  Coming up with your own style / pattern.  It’s great, especially for kids who have an artistic flair.  Personally, I think this is more for older kids, simply because this is not a “paint-by-numbers” kit.  You have to actually come up with a design.  Granted, if an adult wants to come up with a design, and have the child color it in, that works also.
text_fidelity_b: Creativity for Kids Spark!Lab Smithsonian Invent Super Shoes Coloring Kit

text_fidelity_a: Creativity For Kids Spark!Lab Smithsonian "Invent Boundless Bridges" Building Set Spark!Lab offers a number of different kits for inventing / creating / building things.  Each kit has a different “theme”.  This one is “bridges”.  I found this kit is probably better suited for older kids, because there are not a lot of instructions, and you’ll need to be quite creative.  But it could be for anyone who like to “tinker” and create.  I think the idea here is less about following instructions, and more about being creative and coming up with your own ideas.  If your child stumbles with the creative side, then helpful adult ideas might be appreciated to get them started.  Again, this isn’t a kind of “paint-by-numbers” kit. . . and it’s not supposed to be.  It’s a kit to get kids thinking on their own.  There are a lot of pieces, and I really think it’s a great kit.
text_fidelity_b: Creativity For Kids Spark!Lab Smithsonian "Invent Boundless Bridges" Building Set

text_fidelity_a: Creativity for Kids Spark!Lab Smithsonian Inventor's Studio This is a REALLY cool set.  There are actually several different sets sold as part of the Spark!Lab.  This one is more about “outdoors”.  There are 120 pieces inside.  Just about everything you’ll need for your projects. . . though you’re also welcome to add other items, if you wish.  This kit is especially great for “beginners” not knowing how to get started.  There is an “idea starter” ball to get you going.  Granted, especially for younger kids, and adult and/or teacher might also want to help along in the beginning.  There’s so many things which come into play. . . building. . . creating.. . physics. . . planning. . .etc. etc. etc.
text_fidelity_b: Creativity for Kids Spark!Lab Smithsonian Inventor's Studio

text_fidelity_a: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Scra-ffiti Scratch Art Alex toys makes a multitude of different “Scra-ffiti” scratch art books.  This is the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles one.  These are great for long rides in the car.  You don’t need anything other than what is included. . . The book, and the wooden stylus, so it’s simple and easy.  The pictures start out black and white.  Then they are “colorized” with the wooden stylus.  Nothing to it, but it’s fun to do and see what colors are underneath.
text_fidelity_b: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Scra-ffiti Scratch Art

text_fidelity_a:
Schleich North America Horse Club Arabian Mare Playset If you’re looking for a horse to play with, there are other (better) offerings, like the Schleich Horse Feeding Play Set.
